title: objectql: hook-binder and the bare-name cold-boot warning still say a clashing function name is refused; the bind fails and the owner group stays unbound
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (code-side remainder named by card #33569, whose skills fix is PR #33668; the skills lane does not edit `packages/objectql/**`).

Two texts in `packages/objectql` still describe a clashing bare **function** name the way the skill used to ("refused"), while on `main` no install door judges a function: the hook binder's bind (`claimBareNameFunctions`) throws, `bindAppArtifactHandlers` catches it per owner group and logs "Failed to bind declarative hooks" at `error`, the package installs, and every function and hook of that owner group stays unbound.

1. `packages/objectql/src/hook-binder.ts` around lines 210 to 216: the comment says "this refusal stays until the trailing backstop child (ADR-0150 D9) narrows it". That child has landed; the comment should say what the bind does now (and that the throw is caught per owner group).
2. `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` `bareNameColdBootWarning` (around line 2960): "a further package declaring the name is refused at install". True for the registry's covered types; for a function the bind fails instead. Make the sentence type-accurate (or name functions apart), and keep any pinned test text in step.

## What lands

The two texts corrected against the code on `main`, with any test that pins the warning text updated. Whether the bind should instead refuse the install, or bind the non-clashing members of the group, is the owning lane's design call: say so on this card if it wants a ruling.

## Reader

The lane that owns `packages/objectql` (server). Not graded here; triage decides.
